description: This file defines the IEventHandler interface within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It declares four pure virtual methods corresponding to different OCI container events, used for event handling related to OCI container lifecycle and state changes.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling OCI container events with four pure virtual methods.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Handle event when an OCI container starts.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Handle event when an OCI container stops.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Handle event when an OCI container encounters a failure.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Handle event when the OCI container state changes.
